import re
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
ed = doc['word/document.xml']
W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'

HEADLINE_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9 .,:;'&()/%-]*$")

def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        if t.firstChild is not None:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue)
    return ''.join(parts)

def add_underline(run):
    rprs = run.getElementsByTagName('w:rPr')
    rpr = rprs[0] if rprs else None
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = run.ownerDocument.createElementNS(W, 'w:rPr')
        run.insertBefore(rpr, run.firstChild)
    if rpr.getElementsByTagName('w:u'):
        return False
    u = run.ownerDocument.createElementNS(W, 'w:u')
    u.setAttributeNS(W, 'w:val', 'single')
    rpr.appendChild(u)
    return True

changed = 0
for p in ed.dom.getElementsByTagName('w:p'):
    text = para_text(p)
    if not text or not HEADLINE_RE.match(text):
        continue
    runs = [r for r in p.getElementsByTagName('w:r') if para_text(r) or True]
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName('w:r'):
        if add_underline(r):
            changed += 1
    print('UNDERLINED HEADLINE:', repr(text))

print('runs underlined:', changed)
doc.save()
print('saved')

import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'

for prefix, uri in [
    ('ve', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006'),
    ('o', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office'),
    ('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'),
    ('v', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml'),
    ('wp', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing'),
    ('w10', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word'),
    ('w', W),
]:
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

RPR_ORDER = [
    'rStyle', 'rFonts', 'b', 'bCs', 'i', 'iCs', 'caps', 'smallCaps',
    'strike', 'dstrike', 'outline', 'shadow', 'emboss', 'imprint',
    'noProof', 'snapToGrid', 'vanish', 'webHidden', 'color', 'spacing',
    'w', 'kern', 'position', 'sz', 'szCs', 'highlight', 'u', 'effect',
    'bdr', 'shd', 'fitText', 'vertAlign', 'rtl', 'cs', 'em', 'lang',
    'eastAsianLayout', 'specVanish', 'oMath',
]
RANK = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(RPR_ORDER)}


def lname(tag):
    return tag.rsplit('}', 1)[-1]


def para_text(p):
    return ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter('{%s}t' % W))


def is_headline(p):
    # Headlines in this report are short section-title lines in all caps.
    s = para_text(p).strip()
    return (0 < len(s) <= 64 and s == s.upper()
            and any(c.isalpha() for c in s))


def ensure_underline(r):
    rpr = r.find('{%s}rPr' % W)
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = ET.Element('{%s}rPr' % W)
        r.insert(0, rpr)
    u = rpr.find('{%s}u' % W)
    if u is None:
        u = ET.Element('{%s}u' % W)
        at = -1
        for i, ch in enumerate(rpr):
            n = lname(ch.tag)
            if n in RANK and RANK[n] < RANK['u']:
                at = i
        rpr.insert(at + 1, u)
    u.set('val', 'single')


def main():
    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'unpacked/word/document.xml'
    tree = ET.parse(path)
    root = tree.getroot()
    count = 0
    for p in root.iter('{%s}p' % W):
        if not is_headline(p):
            continue
        for r in p.iter('{%s}r' % W):
            ensure_underline(r)
        count += 1
    tree.write(path, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
    print('underlined %d headline paragraph(s)' % count)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    u.set('{%s}val' % W, 'single')
